goal: Prevent HTTP keepalive and proxy connection desync by omitting the body on HEAD responses per RFC 9110
agreement: No substantive review or approvals yet
Queried whether to reject HEAD entirely instead, answered by author that RFC still bans body on 405 (pinheadmz)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fixes connection buffer desync for pipelined or pooled keepalive connections behind proxies
P2 because unauthenticated RPC 405 errors and REST endpoints both leak body bytes to any connected client
